title: Second Herat War
text: The Second Herat War was the invasion of the surrounding realm of Herat and the successful siege of its citadel by the Qajar army led by Morad Mirza Hesam o-Saltaneh. The 1856 siege was part of the concerted Qajar effort to conquer western Afghanistan, known as the Herat Question. The conflict was also a part of the broader Great Game between the British Empire and the Russian Empire.
